text_block_list.text:
It's been several days since the spring
Tenno Sho,
and now we're now readying
for the upcoming
Japan Cup.

Mihono Bourbon has collected any and
all data
regarding Tokai Teio, including
materials she's
already analyzed before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Initiating input.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's pulling ahead with those graceful
strides of
hers and—there she goes, right
past the finish
line! What a great run
from Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What an effortless victory... She was a
full three
lengths ahead of the
runner-up. And she looks
quite at ease
both physically and mentally.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: So this is what talent looks like...

Tokai Teio is known as the Monarch and
was the
Twin Crown champion two years
ago.

She climbed to the top of the Twinkle
Series with
a combination of natural
talent and tireless
effort.

After sustaining an injury at the
Japanese Derby,
all her hard work and
achievements came
unraveled.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Initiating data playback. Inputting data
for
"Tokai Teio."

Though Mihono Bourbon is eager when
she starts
watching the recordings, her
expression gradually
darkens.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's time again for this year's Kikuka Sho!
This race
is looking to be an exciting
one!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Regrettably, Tokai Teio, who everyone
was
expecting to become the Triple
Crown champion,
has to sit this one out
due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's really too bad. I was looking forward
to seeing
Tokai Teio run.

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio, who missed out on an
undefeated
Triple Crown run, is
currently training her hardest
in
preparation for her comeback.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's too bad about the Kikuka Sho, but
I'm not out
of the game yet!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You haven't seen anything yet!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Just as Tokai Teio recovered from the
fracture
she sustained last year and
rejoined the Twinkle
Series...

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have suffered another
injury.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No way! Teio's hurt again?! Is she gonna
be okay?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
There are other up-and-comers showing
up every
day... I feel like her days in the
spotlight are
coming to an end.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Not yet... I'm not done yet! I'm just
getting
started!

After this, Tokai Teio successfully
returns to
racing again.

She declares she's aiming for the Japan
Cup, and
the video ends.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is not the first time I have watched
footage
of her two victories in the
Classic Triple Crown
tour...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
But I can understand her "happiness"
now more
than ever.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
And... I can understand her "frustration"
just as
much.

Mihono Bourbon clenches her fists
tightly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Do you think she's "okay" now?

Worrying about it won't change
anything, though,
and we need to focus
on our own path to victory.

When I tell Mihono Bourbon this, she
nods, but
her expression remains
troubled.

We head to the track to get some fresh
air and
reset, but we're not the only
ones there.
Tokai Teio is there training too.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Teio...

She's running at full tilt, as if her laps are
being
timed.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I won't lose, I won't lose, I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win the Japan Cup!

She sprints past the finish line with a
mighty
shout.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant... All right, a new record!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not done yet!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Status—"shock."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was incapable of looking away from
Teio as she
ran. Considering this, and
the emotions that
surfaced as I watched,
I conclude...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analysis complete. Verdicts are
consistent. Teio
has given me "courage."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In general terms, "courage" is defined by
the act
of dauntlessly moving forward in
the face of fear
and doubt.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have inputted this information into my
database
as it pertains to becoming "a
runner who inspires
courage in others."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Teio has this "courage."

Mihono Bourbon's gaze remains fixed
upon Tokai
Teio as she continues racing
around the track.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Courage is warm and full of power.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I now know what it means to be inspired
with
courage. Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I understand how much power someone
must
possess to inspire others.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have determined that I must strengthen
my body
further. Let us move on to
training.

We take our training today more
seriously than
ever before.

After training, I realize I forgot
something at the
track and head back
for it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hup, hup, hup!

Her endurance is admirable, but it's
almost
curfew.

I'm about to suggest that she wrap
things up, but
another voice rings out
before I can say anything.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Burning the midnight oil, Tokai Teio?

It's Symboli Rudolf, a strict Umamusume
who
serves as Tracen Academy's student
council
president.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Prez! Hehe. I don't wanna lose the
Japan
Cup, so I've gotta train hard.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Bourbon said she's entering too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Really now? She's been compared to you
quite
often ever since she started her
classic year.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I know. That's why I'm keeping an eye on
her! I
saw her run at the spring Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She's been living rent free in my head
ever since. I
was shocked and
frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But also super excited at the same time!
The
Japan Cup will be a fun race for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta come and watch me run my
hardest,
Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Of course. Since you insist.

Symboli Rudolf smiles warmly at Tokai
Teio as she
babbles excitedly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Ehehe!

I had no idea this was the case, and I bet
Mihono
Bourbon doesn't either.

From the looks of Tokai Teio's training,
she's
going to be giving it her all in the
Japan Cup.

Hearing Tokai Teio's impassioned
speech gives
me a sense of renewed
vigor.
